name: Consulting & professional services
gate_detail: A WFOE can be registered for management consulting, marketing, technical advisory, market research and similar scopes. No sector licence is required for the company itself.
tagline: The default WFOE: an invoice, a payroll and a desk.
reality: Registration is the easy part. The scope on the licence must match what you actually bill, and the line between consulting and regulated advice — legal, tax, securities, education, medical — is enforced when a client complains or an invoice looks wrong.
watch: Do not write 'investment advice', 'legal services' or 'medical consulting' into the scope because it sounds impressive. It invites a licence you do not have.

name: Software & SaaS
gate: ICP filing; ICP/EDI licence for online services
gate_detail: Software development and B2B licensing are open. Operating a commercial website or app that serves users in China generally needs an ICP filing, and paid online services may need an ICP or EDI licence — where foreign equity is capped.
tagline: Sell code freely; sell access to a Chinese website and the telecom rules arrive.
reality: The foreign-equity cap on value-added telecom services is the reason many software founders sell to businesses through a WFOE and keep the consumer platform offshore — or license it to a domestic partner.
watch: A server in Singapore does not remove the obligation if your customers, payment and marketing are in China. Ask a telecom lawyer before you build the billing flow.

name: E-commerce & retail
gate: ICP/EDI, product registrations, food or cosmetics licences
gate_detail: Cross-border e-commerce into China can be run from abroad through a bonded platform. Selling domestically — a Tmall or Douyin store operated by a Chinese entity — needs a local company, ICP filing and the product-specific registrations.
tagline: Selling into China and selling inside China are two different businesses.
reality: The margin is in the licence and the logistics, not the storefront. Food, cosmetics, supplements and medical devices each carry their own registration or filing, and a marketplace will ask for it before your first sale.
watch: Do not import inventory before the product registration is in the name of the entity that will sell it. Re-labelling a shipment is not a compliance strategy.

name: Import/export & logistics
gate: Customs registration; road transport licence for domestic trucking
gate_detail: A trading WFOE can hold foreign-trade operator status and clear goods. International freight forwarding needs a filing; domestic road transport needs a road-transport licence and vehicles registered to the entity.
tagline: The simplest cash-flow business to start, and the hardest to get paid for.
reality: Import/export is a working-capital business. The entity is easy; the credit terms, the customs classification and the 90-day receivables are what decide whether it survives.
watch: A forwarder that offers to 'borrow' your import quota or invoice through a friend's company is offering you a tax problem with a Chinese name on it.

name: Manufacturing & hardware
gate: Environmental impact assessment, fire, safety, land use
gate_detail: Foreign-investment restrictions in manufacturing were reduced to zero in the 2024 negative list. The gate is now environmental approval, factory zoning, fire and safety inspection — and the landlord's right to let you operate there.
tagline: The negative list is no longer the obstacle; the landlord and the EIA are.
reality: A factory lease signed before the environmental impact assessment is a bet that the assessment will pass. In many districts it will not, and the deposit is gone. Budget for the EIA, utilities and a compliant waste contract before equipment.
watch: Do not accept a landlord's assurance that 'the address is fine for industry'. Ask for the zoning certificate and the previous tenant's EIA approval, in writing.

name: Food & beverage
gate: Food business licence, fire, health, alcohol licence
gate_detail: A restaurant WFOE needs a food business licence tied to the premises, a fire inspection, staff health certificates and — for alcohol — a separate liquor licence. The premises must be zoned for food service.
tagline: A restaurant is a property deal with a kitchen attached.
reality: The address decides the business: grease traps, ventilation, gas, waste and neighbouring consent are all physical. A cheap unit that cannot pass the kitchen inspection is the most common way a foreign F&B founder loses a year.
watch: Do not sign a five-year lease on a site whose previous tenant was not a restaurant. The extraction and waste infrastructure is usually the whole problem.

name: Education & training
equity: Joint venture or domestic partner; compulsory education closed to FIEs
gate: Private school licence; curriculum and teacher approvals
gate_detail: Foreign-invested schools are limited to non-compulsory stages and generally require a Chinese partner. Compulsory education is closed to foreign ownership, and after-school tutoring in core subjects has been heavily restricted since 2021.
tagline: The widest gap between what founders plan and what is licensable.
reality: Language training, test prep, early-years and corporate training sit under different rules, and the local education bureau applies them differently. A licence to teach adults is not a licence to teach children.
watch: Do not open classrooms while the licence is 'in progress'. The inspection that closes you is usually triggered by a parent, not a competitor.

name: Healthcare & clinics
equity: Generally joint venture; wholly foreign-owned pilot in selected cities
gate_detail: Medical institutions are generally limited to joint ventures, with a pilot allowing wholly foreign-owned hospitals in a changing list of cities and provinces. Every clinician needs a Chinese practising registration in the specialty.
tagline: Pilot cities change; leases do not.
reality: The health commission, not the company registry, decides whether you can operate. Approval depends on beds, departments, equipment, infection control and the named medical director — and the process is local.
watch: Do not lease or equip a clinic until the local health commission confirms, in writing, that your proposed scope and ownership structure are eligible in that district.

name: Tourism & hospitality
equity: 100% foreign-owned for inbound; outbound travel closed to FIEs
gate: Travel agency licence and deposit; hotel licences
gate_detail: Inbound travel agencies can be wholly foreign-owned with a licence and a quality deposit. Outbound travel — selling trips that Chinese residents take abroad — is restricted to domestic-invested agencies. Hotels need fire, health and special-industry licences.
tagline: Inbound is the niche a foreign founder can actually own.
reality: The licence and deposit are only the entry ticket. Distribution in China runs through platforms and licensed agencies, and a hotel's star rating is a licensing process, not a marketing label.
watch: If your product is 'we take Chinese guests abroad', you are in outbound travel. A WFOE cannot hold that licence, and routing it through a friend's agency is a compliance problem, not a structure.

name: Media & content
equity: News, publishing and film production prohibited; some content services via JV
gate: Licences that are rarely granted to foreign-owned entities
gate_detail: News gathering, publishing, film production, distribution and cinema chains are prohibited to foreign investors. Advertising, design, events and some online content services are open, but the content itself is regulated.
tagline: The shortest part of the negative list to read, and the hardest to work around.
reality: Most foreign media founders end up as a production, advertising or technology company selling services to licensed Chinese publishers — not as the publisher. That is a different business with a different margin.
watch: Do not describe your entity as a 'media company' or 'publisher' in its scope unless you have the licence. The scope is evidence.

name: Design & creative
access: Open, with qualifications for some work
gate: Business licence; design qualifications for construction-related work
gate_detail: Brand, industrial, interior and digital design are open. Construction design, engineering and anything that stamps a drawing for a permit require a Chinese design qualification and registered personnel, which a new WFOE will not have.
tagline: Design the brand freely; do not stamp the drawing.
reality: Creative founders underprice the qualification boundary. A studio that designs a fit-out is fine; a studio that signs the drawing for the fit-out permit is practising engineering without a licence.
watch: Keep the contract for construction documents with a qualified local design institute. Your name can be on the concept, not on the stamp.

name: Finance & fintech
equity: Licence-specific caps; often joint venture or domestic control
gate: Financial licence from the regulator before registration
gate_detail: Payments, lending, securities, fund distribution, insurance and crypto-related activity each have their own regulator, capital requirement and foreign-equity cap. A software company that touches client money is regulated as a financial business.
tagline: A licensing business, not a software business.
reality: The licence comes first, and it is usually granted to an entity with a domestic shareholder, a capital base and a regulatory history. A new WFOE with a good app is not a candidate for most financial licences.
watch: Do not hold, pool or transmit client funds through a consulting WFOE while 'waiting for the licence'. That is the fact pattern regulators treat as unlicensed payment business.
